reviewMethod: Manual read of all six pinned upstream runtime files and all six existing target test files; compare actions, assertions and order, not title similarity. Existing dirty tests retained. No legacy Solid source consulted.

sourcePredicates.jsdom: No source skip; also executable in browser unless explicitly classified otherwise.
sourcePredicates.browser: Source describe.skipIf(isJSDOM) or it.skipIf(isJSDOM); actual layout belongs to browser, not mocked-jsdom parity.
sourcePredicates.blink: Viewport subtree animations describe.skipIf(isJSDOM), plus it.skipIf(!platform.engine.blink); CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage required.
sourcePredicates.targetPredicates: Existing browserCase is browser-only; existing GC registration additionally skipIf(!platform.engine.blink). Existing SSR is server-only. No skips added.

conformance.evidence: Read upstream describeConformance and propForwarding/renderProp helper bodies and target describeConformance. Reference lists the 15 exact generated source cases including duplicated titles separated by line/parameters. Newly invoked target helper preserves forwarding lang/data, style override, wrapper, two refs, class callback composition. Previous 12 aggregate cases did not assert custom lang/data, wrapper/two refs, render-class composition or style override; they are retained separately.
